HANET Connect Gateway includes unmodified ThroughTek Kalay/TUTK runtime files
for Linux amd64, Linux armv7, Linux aarch64, and Windows amd64.

Linux runtime source:
  https://github.com/mrlt8/docker-wyze-bridge
  Commit: bf893749b748f142199c9bce14fac44f8a661d6e

Windows development runtime source:
  https://github.com/miguelangel-nubla/videoP2Proxy

unmodified for personal, non-commercial interoperability. They are provided
without warranty. See TUTK-LICENSE.txt in this directory.
